title: First Olympic Games
description: Added from the Generations curriculum import (Preparing the World for Jesus (1st ed., 2020)). Sorted by the CFAH anchor point cited below (added by the Herodotus import); the Generations dates are display only.

chronologies.citation: Griffith & White, "Chronological Framework of Ancient History. 3: Anchor Points of Ancient History," ARJ 16 (2023): 131–154, section "AP-10: Era of the Olympiad: 776/775 B.C."
chronologies.note: CFAH-3: "These two durations confirm 776/775 B.C. for the first Olympiad, 525 B.C. for the Battle of Pelusium, and 560/559 B.C. for Cyrus, synchronizing the chronologies of Egypt, Greece, and Persia." Censorinus's eras: "1st Olympiad: 1,014 years [yields 776 B.C.]". AP-12 and AP-13 count from this era.
